verdict: Ads are running but leads aren't being captured — fixing that now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 308 clicks on $159.10 in spend, but zero leads were recorded — conversion tracking or landing page capture is broken, meaning real interest is being lost before it reaches you. Spend increased 66.81% in the last 7 days, which makes resolving this the immediate priority; more budget without lead capture in place doesn't produce leads. A set of foundational build items — including landing pages, conversion tracking, and CRM setup — are overdue and are being addressed as a single remediation push this week. You should not expect lead volume to reflect the campaign activity until that infrastructure is confirmed working. Once it is, the click volume already being generated gives a real baseline to build from.

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking and landing pages are not capturing leads, so paid clicks are not converting to contacts.
